notes: «وجدت في كتاب أبي بخطه» is read from the father's book, so the father is a relation link (occurrence 1 of the word أبي); the Imam Ali speaks inside Abu Ma'mar's story («فقال علي بن أبي طالب»), so he is the last link (ruling 2 and 5); «بنيسابور» is a place, left out; the footnote numbers are left out
